purpose: Planted controls for done_judge. A known-open control carries evidence that looks like completion and is not: a promise to do the work later, a meeting where the work was only discussed, the other party promising, the user chasing, an unsent draft, and one control per guard in validate(). A known_done control carries evidence that is completion. A judge that closes any known-open control is broken; so is one that closes no known_done control. Every person, firm and address here is invented. 'damning' is the sentence a careless reader would cite, which is what the stub runner cites; 'guard' names the check that must stop it; 'stub' overrides one field of the stub's answer.
